task.title: Connect the bounded reducer to the relational projection store
task.head_binding: The reviewer must bind this committed manifest to the exact final PR head; this pre-review artifact deliberately does not claim a future merge SHA.

not_changing: BFF reader selection or route behavior

runtime_contract.activation: Only LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_WRITER_BACKEND=shadow constructs RelationalLifecycleProjector; disabled, json, and legacy_json retain the legacy worker. Any other enabled value fails closed.
runtime_contract.credential_boundary: LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_PROJECTION_DSN is required for shadow writes and ProjectionStore bootstrap remains false, so the worker performs no runtime DDL.
runtime_contract.source_and_checkpoint: The shadow worker reads bounded global telemetry sequence batches. Every row receives one durable applied, ignored, or quarantined receipt, allowing ProjectionStore to advance only its database-derived contiguous checkpoint.
runtime_contract.bounded_state: A poll hydrates only each journey touched by the batch from journey_stages.contract_fields, resets bounded reducer counters after hydration, and discards that batch-local materializer on the next poll. It does not read, serialize, or advance controller_state.json, aggregate JSON, or generation bundles.
runtime_contract.atomicity: Receipts, quarantine rows, identity links, stages, journey summary, loop summary, controller revision, source high watermark, and contiguous checkpoint are passed together to one ProjectionStore.execute_batch_transaction call.
runtime_contract.rollback: Leave the BFF reader on its accepted backend and stop the shadow writer. The additive relational schema and last legacy JSON generation remain read-only rollback evidence; no legacy truth is advanced by this worker.

verification.coverage: real PostgreSQL transaction, restart hydration, exact duplicate no-rewrite, ignored receipt, contiguous checkpoint, and no controller_state.json write
focused lifecycle, reducer, projection-store, canonical paper integration, and adjacent Trade Journey suites
unit composition, transaction-failure non-advance, static no legacy snapshot serialization assertion, and existing lifecycle compatibility

required_checks: verify shadow is the only accepted relational writer activation
reproduce the real-Postgres restart/duplicate/ignored receipt regression
inspect that RelationalLifecycleProjector has no legacy controller-state or full-corpus serialization path
verify one mutation contains only batch receipts and affected journey rows
bind this manifest to the exact PR head in the governed approve command
